newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 37.5 PCT OF ANNUAL.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - STATE BUDGET COLLECTS 37.5 PCT OF ANNUAL.

text.p: Estonia's state budget had collected 4.69 billion kroons or 37.5 percent of its yearly planned revenues in five months, compared to 35.9 percent in the same period in 1996, the ministry of finance said on Tuesday.
Revenue from VAT collection amounted to 2.31 billion kroons or 39.9 percent of the annual plan, the ministry added in a statement.
Personal income tax collection was at 38.8 percent of the annual plan, corporate income tax collection was 34.5 percent and excise tax collection reached 33.9 percent.
Revenue from tobacco and beer excise taxes will exceed the planned targets as they are at 48.8 and 41.1 percent, the ministry said.
